seasons.title: Pick your season
seasons.text: Spring and autumn usually bring the clearest mountain views. The monsoon brings green valleys and cloudier peaks.

altitude.title: Go slowly at altitude
altitude.text: Above about 3,000 m, rest days help your body adjust. Shorter routes are a good start if you are new to trekking.

culture.title: Travel with respect
culture.text: Walk clockwise around stupas, ask before photographing people and dress modestly at temples.
